invented.quote: including the ones who'd been with me for years
invented.why: The brief mentions existing clients, but does not state how long they have been with the bookkeeper or that any have been clients for years.

invented.quote: Nobody gets a special intro rate that goes up later.
invented.why: The brief does not state whether the bookkeeper offers promotional or introductory rates.

invented.quote: Any other day, I'm the one who picks up.
invented.why: The brief only states that the bookkeeper does not answer the phone on Sundays or Mondays, not that they answer the phone every other day of the week.
